ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has commissioned Phase-I (53.63 MW/300 MWh) of its Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) project in Rajasthan, marking a significant step in developing its large-scale FDRE initiative. However, a key takeaway and potential red flag is that only the BESS component is operational, with the corresponding renewable energy generation component still under development; this materially impacts immediate full project functionality and delays potential revenue realization until the entire system is integrated.
